physicalNotes: Radius: Caph is a rapid rotator: Che et al. (2011), ApJ 732, 68 measure an equatorial radius of 3.79 and a polar radius of 3.06 solar radii with CHARA/MIRC. The record's radius is the volume-equivalent sphere of those two, 3.53 solar radii; the scene draws the measured flattening, with the equatorial radius on the outline. Adopted 2,455,210 km, 3.5291 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis, the measured rotation pole, is up.
